purpose: Teach: 友の会/回分/新譜/吹き替え/データー/ゲージ/コンソール/特番

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域の友の会と連携されますね
lines.en: The police collaborate with community groups, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, collaborative tone. Leans in slightly, inviting agreement. Gentle upward inflection on the closing question particle, building rapport rather than interrogating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、研修を年間十回分実施されますね
lines.en: They also conduct about ten training sessions a year, I understand?
lines.style: Impressed but understated acknowledgment. Light emphasis on 'ten'—genuinely noting the scope of effort. Conversational cadence, as if piecing together an admirable picture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯啓発の新譜CDを配布されますね
lines.en: And they distribute those new crime-prevention awareness CDs, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, noticing the breadth of initiative. Pause before 'new'—recognizing thoughtfulness. Tone stays warm, slightly wondering at the range of activities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外捜査映像の吹き替え準備もされますね
lines.en: They're even preparing dubbed versions of overseas investigation footage, aren't they?
lines.style: Light surprise underneath composure. Slight uptick in energy on 'even'—genuine curiosity about the specifics. Still collaborative, but now admiring the ambition of the effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪統計データーを毎月分析されますね
lines.en: And you analyze crime statistics data every month?
lines.style: Genuine interest in the detail work. Steady, methodical pace reflecting the regular rhythm of monthly analysis. Slight nod in the voice—acknowledging the discipline required.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場用ゲージで距離計測もされますね
lines.en: You use calibrated gauges at crime scenes for distance measurement too, right?
lines.style: Precise appreciation. Brief pause before 'calibrated'—respecting the exactness required. Technical but warm, showing knowledge without condescension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内コンソールでリアルタイム監視もされますね
lines.en: Your station console does real-time monitoring as well, doesn't it?
lines.style: Measured respect for the infrastructure. Slight awe underneath—recognizing modern capability. Slow delivery, allowing weight to settle on each system's importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民向け防犯特番にもご出演されますね
lines.en: And you've even appeared on citizen-focused crime-prevention specials?
lines.style: Genuine warmth now, tinged with light amusement. Soft emphasis on 'even'—delighted at the reach into public consciousness. More relaxed, almost proud of the visibility.
